en: Rydel
Welcome to Rydel's Cycles! I'm Rydel, and I love bicycles more than anything.
Say, you look like a traveller. Did you come all the way here from somewhere far off?
Then you'll need a bike to get around Hoenn! I'll give you one, free. Which kind would you like?
The Mach Bike is built for speed, fast enough to ride up a muddy slope. The Acro Bike can hop and balance on rails.
Which bike will you take?
Mach Bike
Acro Bike
The Mach Bike! Hold on tight, it really flies.
The Acro Bike! You'll be doing tricks in no time.
If you want to try the other kind, just come back. I'll swap them for you any time!
Oh, you're local? Then you probably don't need a bike from me. Come back if you change your mind!
Want to swap your bike for the other kind?
Hm? You're not carrying your bike. Is it in your PC? Bring it along and I'll swap it.
Right, the Acro Bike for the Mach Bike. Here you go!
Come back whenever you feel like swapping again.
Right, the Mach Bike for the Acro Bike. Here you go!
Come back whenever you feel like swapping again.
Glad you like the one you've got! Ride safely.

"The Mach Bike is the fastest bike there is. Point it where you want to go and hold on!"

Bumpy slopes

"The Acro Bike can hop onto a narrow rail and ride along it. It can't turn while it's up there!"
"A bumpy slope is too rough for any other bike, but the Acro Bike can hop its way up."
